author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
Discover a gallery of artifacts from across @disneyanimation Studios history 💭 #DisneyWorld
The Magic of Disney Animation opens September 14 at Disney’s Hollywood Studios ✨

Explore Treasures Untold, a gallery packed with keepsakes, mementos, and iconic artifacts from across the history of Walt Disney Animation Studios. 

For the first time at Walt Disney World, all 64 animated feature films are represented throughout this imaginative, fan-first setting, meaning that your favorite character, story, or hidden reference could be waiting right where you least expect it.

About Walt Disney World:
At Walt Disney World, you've got a whole fantastic world to celebrate in! With four spectacular theme parks and two water parks plus the most amazing shopping, dining, and recreation magic imaginable, it's no wonder all of life's special moments are made even more enjoyable when you celebrate at Walt Disney World.
